1.explanation: This script directly invokes the manifest-short-name-length audit from the Lighthouse codebase. We feed it two scenarios: 1) an empty manifest and 2) a manifest that has a valid `name` but no `short_name`. In both cases, the audit will compute the length of `short_name` as zero, fail (`rawValue: false`), and report “Found: 0 chars,” reproducing the false-positive behavior observed in the bug report.
1.bug_scenario: When a web app manifest is missing the “short_name” field (even if it has a valid “name”), the manifest-short-name-length audit treats its length as 0 and fails with a “Found: 0 chars” error, resulting in a false positive.
